name: Mortgage Debt Consolidation Calculator
meta_description: Compare a cash-out refinance that pays off your cards and loans with keeping your current mortgage and debts: new payment, total interest and real cost.
subtitle: Compare refinancing your mortgage for more than you owe to pay off your other debts with keeping your current mortgage and paying the debts as you do now. See the new payment, the total cost of each path and how much of it comes from changing your mortgage rate.

Your home secures all of it

A cash-out refinance turns unsecured debt into mortgage debt and replaces your current mortgage rate with the new one. Spreading card debt over 30 years can cost more in total even at a lower rate, and the savings vanish if the cards are run up again.
